title: Radiation pressure on a dielectric slab: optical force vs thickness (analytic)
description:
A plane wave (line source spanning the y period, em_fdfd_ez at 1550 nm) hits a lossless glass slab (n = 1.5) in vacuum; em_solid_optical_force hands the force density -(eps0/4) |E_z|^2 grad eps_r to the solid, and a Fixed (domain) support on the slab itself holds it, so minus its reaction is the total force on the slab. Stationary study, swept over the slab thickness d (60..460 nm, every value a whole number of 10 nm cells; the base 260 nm runs last).
Analytic (momentum balance of a lossless slab): F_x = 2 R P_inc / c per m of depth, P_inc = A^2 Ly / (2 eta0), Airy reflectance R = F sin^2(delta) / (1 + F sin^2(delta)), delta = 2 pi n d / lambda, F = ((n^2 - 1) / (2 n))^2; transmitted power (1 - R) P_inc. R peaks (0.148) at the quarter wave d = lambda / (4 n) = 258 nm and vanishes at the half wave 517 nm.
Sweep tab: force_x, P_trans and R_measured vs d_slab with the dashed analytic curves. Derived values tab: the same per run with their references. Expect ~0.5 % on force_x near the quarter wave: the face form of the force is not the discretely conserved one, an error of O((n k0 dx)^2 / 2) ~2e-3 of each interface term (~0.6 P_inc / c), so where R is small (60 nm, 460 nm) the relative error grows to a few %; ~4e-4 on P_trans; R_measured = 1 - P_trans / P_inc (relative to R) ~2e-3 where R is not small, ~1 % at 60 / 460 nm (R ~0.02).
Line profile tab (base d = 260 nm): E_transmitted = |E_z| behind the slab vs A sqrt(1 - R). Field tab: em.ez_abs and the coupled body force solid.body_force_x (two opposite face forces, net along +x).

parameters.name: d_slab
parameters.description: slab thickness (26 cells, ~a quarter wave); swept

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the FDFD solve

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x (CPML outside both x faces)

parameters.name: x_slab
parameters.description: slab front face (on a cell edge)

parameters.name: x_source
parameters.description: line source x (cell centre), in vacuum

parameters.name: x_trans
parameters.description: transmission flux line x (cell centre), behind the slab

parameters.name: A_src
parameters.description: line source amplitude in V/m (radiated to each side)

parameters.name: P_inc
parameters.description: incident power in W/m the source sends toward +x: A^2 Ly / (2 eta0)

parameters.name: F_coef
parameters.description: coefficient of finesse F of the slab in vacuum (0.174 for n = 1.5)

parameters.name: delta_slab
parameters.description: single-pass phase of the slab in rad

parameters.name: F_rad
parameters.description: analytic radiation force on the slab in N/m
